items.title: Drew Lock: Injures oblique during Week 9 win
items.text:
Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said after Sunday's 17-3 win over the Cardinals that Lock sustained an oblique injury during the game, leaving Lock's availability for Week 10 against the Raiders up in the air, Bob Condotta of the Seattle Times reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyler Shough: Does just enough in OT win
items.text:
Shough completed 21 of 35 passes for 265 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-22 overtime win over the Browns.

items.title: Daniel Jones: Staying with Indy
items.text:
Jones will remain with the Colts through Tuesday's trade deadline after the team informed him Saturday that he won't be moved, Tom Pelissero of The Ringer reports.

items.title: Chris Olave: Big day in OT win over Browns
items.text:
Olave caught seven of 12 targets for 98 yards in Sunday's 23-22 overtime win over Cleveland.

items.text:

items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Two TDs on 20 touches in Week 9
items.text:
McCaffrey rushed 18 times for 68 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 38-17 win over the Raiders.

items.title: KC Concepcion: Finds end zone for first time
items.text:
Concepcion caught four of six targets for 85 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-22 overtime loss to the Saints. He added three yards on his only carry.
